title: Ummat ne hai
body:
baade rasool kaisa ye inquilaab aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
ummat ne hai bhulayi tauqeer mustafa ki
pamaal ho rahi hai tasveer mustafa ki
<<DIVIDER>>
yasrab mein karbala mein mashad mein saamara mein
looti hai ummatiyon ne jageer mustafa ki
pamaal ho rahi hai tasveer mustafa ki
ummat ne hai bhulayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay kalma padne waalon islam kya yehi hai
pehne huwe hai itrat zanjeer mustafa ki
pamaal ho rahi hai tasveer mustafa ki
ummat ne hai bhulayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
qayil ho mustafa ki azmat ke to batao
jhutlayi kyun hai tum ne tehreer mustafa ki
pamaal ho rahi hai tasveer mustafa ki
ummat ne hai bhulayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
min jumla ambiya mein hum ne nigaah ki hai
aulaad e murtaza hai tafseer mustafa ki
pamaal ho rahi hai tasveer mustafa ki
ummat ne hai bhulayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
karte rahenge momin seena zani hamesha
likhta rahega midhat ye ameer mustafa ki
pamaal ho rahi hai tasveer mustafa ki
ummat ne hai bhulayi...
author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi
